Priya (People Ops): Heads up — manager flagged an off-cycle contractor -> FT conversion with a level bump. Effective date requested: 2024-11-01. Need clarity on backdating salary, payroll cutoffs across APAC/EMEA, and what manager evidence we need. @Tom (Comp Ops) @Alex (Payroll) :eyes:
Tom (Comp Ops): Short version: we can do a retro effective date if payroll for the target month hasn't closed. Primary steps: submit comp-change ticket, attach evidence pack, pick a retro_date, and include payroll tag for backpay processing. Will outline below.
Tom (Comp Ops): Steps (high level):
1) Manager files "Comp Change" form in the HRIS and selects "Off-cycle conversion / backdate".
2) Attach evidence pack (offer, manager rationale, performance highlights, comp band recommendation).
3) Add requested effective_date (e.g., 2024-11-01) and desired retro_date if different.
4) Add payroll csv using template and tag with code OFFC_RETRO_AP (we use AP/EMEA-specific tag based on region).
5) Comp Ops routes to Finance for >20% increases or leveling >1 band.
Tom (Comp Ops): CSV template (one row per employee) — paste into the HRIS upload:
```
employee_id,country,currency,old_salary,new_salary,effective_date,retro_date,payroll_code,notes
123456,GBR,GBP,45000,54000,2024-11-01,2024-11-01,OFFC_RETRO_EMEA,conversion contractor->FT + level up to IC4
```
Leah (Manager): Quick Q — payroll for EMEA closed on Oct 25. If we miss that cutoff, what's the realistic outcome?
Alex (Payroll): If cutoff missed we do the adjustment in the next payroll cycle as an off-cycle payment (one-time retro). That usually hits in the following pay period and requires Finance approval and GL mapping. Cutoff dates by region: APAC Oct 28 17:00 local / EMEA Oct 25 17:00 UTC / NA Nov 2 00:00 UTC.
Priya (People Ops): Good to note. Manager should aim to submit by Oct 24 EOD for EMEA to avoid off-cycle. If they must do later, expect an off-cycle run and need extra signoffs.
Tom (Comp Ops): Evidence pack checklist: final signed offer, manager justification (one paragraph), recent performance summary (last 6 months), org chart snippet showing new role, confirmation of contractor termination/last invoice. For conversions include contractor invoice range + termination date.
Leah (Manager): For equity start dates — do we backdate grant start to the effective date or start at conversion processing date?
Tom (Comp Ops): Equity: generally start at the effective_date if comp change and conversion are retro-approved and Finance okays it. For anything retro >90 days we flag to Legal and Comp Leadership. If there are stock plan system constraints we may set grant creation date at process date but grant service date can be retro.
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: use the "off-cycle comp" template & attach all docs. Deadline for avoiding off-cycle EMEA payroll: 2024-10-24 23:59 UTC. Link: https://hris.internal/redwood/offcycle-template :calendar:
Priya (People Ops): I'll draft a short manager-facing checklist and DM you both. Also note: if the salary change crosses a currency boundary (contractor invoiced in USD but employed in GBP), include FX note + GL code and indicate payroll entity.
Alex (Payroll): Also confirm whether benefits enrollment should be retrodated — benefits ops need the conversion date to set eligibility. If retro, benefits effective date may follow internal policy (usually month start after conversion).
Leah (Manager): OK I'll gather docs and submit by Oct 22 to be safe. Thanks all.
Tom (Comp Ops): I'll review the packet when you drop it in the comp-change queue. Ping me if you hit any HRIS form validation errors (we've seen glitches on the currency field).
Priya (People Ops): Closing loop — once submitted, set a Slack thread with comp-change ticket number. We'll track approvals and confirm payroll tag. :white_check_mark:
